detailed_descriptions.en: Explore the remains of a distant dystopian future and survive in a gritty and brutal world of high‑octane, fast‑paced hack‑and‑slash action. Each cycle reveals fragments of forgotten truth about mankind’s self‑inflicted downfall. SWITCH HEROES, CHAIN COMBOS, AND UNLEASH A DEADLY TECHNO-BALLET At the press of a button, seamlessly shapeshift mid‑combat between Flux, Ekku, and Vekta — each with unique abilities, playstyles, and special attacks. Chain attacks and master dozens of combos to turn every run into a seamless, lethal choreography. CHALLENGE EPIC, CINEMATIC, AND PRECISION-DRIVEN BOSSES Each path you take culminates in epic boss encounters where timing, adaptability, and composure are critical to survival. EVERY RUN IS A UNIQUE ITERATION TO EXPLORE Evolve your characters and refine your build each run, so every attempt feels fresh and challenging. Lasting meta‑progression keeps every run meaningful. Risk powerful Devil’s Bargains or tackle Operator’s Trials for high‑stakes rewards! ESCAPE THE ULTIMATE DYSTOPIAN SIMULATION Immerse yourself in a brutal and dark sci‑fi world where each run brings you closer to transcending your own kind. As the last A.I. created by a mysterious Operator and guided by Eden, will you find a way out?
